title: Kamishiro Rui — Brand New Style〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Kamiyama High School - Empty Classroom

rows.Speaker: Greening Committee Chairman
rows.Line: Alright, welcome to the first official meeting of this year's greening committee.

rows.Speaker: Greening Committee Chairman
rows.Line: Aside from the new students, I'm seeing quite a few familiar faces here today...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes.
Many of the members from last year seem to be here, including myself.

rows.Speaker: Second-Year Greening Committee Member A
rows.Line: I have this sort of attachment to the plants I've been taking care of. I feel like I should look after them until I graduate.

rows.Speaker: Third-Year Greening Committee Member A
rows.Line:
I get what you mean...
And things have become a lot easier since you joined, Kamishiro.

rows.Speaker: Second-Year Greening Committee Member B
rows.Line: Yeah, the flower beds aren't getting all messed up anymore thanks to you!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I really don't feel as if I did anything special...
But I appreciate your kind words.

rows.Speaker: Third-Year Greening Committee Member B
rows.Line: Of course. Let's do our best again this year, Kamishiro!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (This committee has changed so much.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (When I first joined, everyone's attitude toward me didn't exactly feel welcoming...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But I'm grateful that they've grown to understand me now...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Although...)

rows.Speaker: First-Year Greening Committee Members
rows.Line:
Hey, isn't that him?
He's one of the Weirdo Wombo Combo...

rows.Speaker: First-Year Greening Committee Members
rows.Line: He flies drones and performs dangerous experiments at school, right? Why's he on the quiet and peaceful greening committee...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Well, I can't blame them for feeling that way...)

rows.Speaker: Greening Committee Chairman
rows.Line:
...
Kamishiro, I have a favor to ask you.
Would you mind telling the new students about what we do?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Huh? Me?

rows.Speaker: Greening Committee Chairman
rows.Line: They probably don't know much about the flower beds, the farm, or other aspects of this committee yet, so I figured you could explain since you're the most well-informed.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: First-Year Greening Committee Members
rows.Line:
Y-You don't have to do that for us!
We can learn as we go...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Understood.
It would be my pleasure to teach you all about the committee.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Everyone, would you mind coming with me?

rows.Speaker: First-Year Greening Committee Members
rows.Line: O-Okay...
Courtyard

rows.Speaker: First-Year Greening Committee Members
rows.Line: I can't believe we have to work with the person at the center of all those rumors...

rows.Speaker: First-Year Greening Committee Members
rows.Line: My friend's big brother even warned me to avoid dealing with him no matter what...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We're here. Listen up, everyone.

rows.Speaker: First-Year Greening Committee Members
rows.Line: O-Okay!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The greening committee is responsible for all of the flower beds you see here in the courtyard.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Most of our duties involve tilling the dirt and planting new flowers, with a different person watering them each day.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We actually just planted the seeds for those flowers over there a few months ago. It's good to see them finally sprouting.

rows.Speaker: First-Year Greening Committee Members
rows.Line: Wow, you guys planted the seeds for these?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, please be careful when touching them. It's difficult to see, but we laid out a net in front of them.

rows.Speaker: First-Year Greening Committee Members
rows.Line:
Whoa, he's right...!
I didn't notice at all. The mesh pattern almost makes it look like a spider web...

rows.Speaker: First-Year Greening Committee Members
rows.Line: But what's its purpose...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This flower bed's been through quite a lot.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The tennis and softball teams kept hitting balls this way, which led to many flowers getting crushed.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I wanted to protect the flowers while not obstructing the view, so I ended up going with a design that would be difficult to see...

rows.Speaker: First-Year Greening Committee Members
rows.Line: Wait, Kamishiro, you made this...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I did.
I felt so bad for the poor flowers.

rows.Speaker: First-Year Greening Committee Members
rows.Line:
...
The guy that conducts all those dangerous experiments feels bad for flowers...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh...
This one appears to have wilted.

rows.Speaker: First-Year Greening Committee Members
rows.Line: Oh, that one is definitely done for. It might be a good idea to pull it out so it doesn't steal nutrients from the other flowers...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Actually...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'll move this flower to a separate planter for now and personally look after it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I'll return it once it has fully recovered.
I bet it prefers to be with its friends...

rows.Speaker: First-Year Greening Committee Members
rows.Line: Kamishiro...

rows.Speaker: First-Year Greening Committee Members
rows.Line:
...
I'm gonna do my best for this committee.

rows.Speaker: First-Year Greening Committee Members
rows.Line: Please teach us all you can!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Of course. Please feel free to ask me any questions you have during these meetings or even outside of them.
